summary: Iter354 (Compliance Gap Detector + Governance Health) Phase 2 P0+P1 — full backend pytest + frontend Playwright regression. Backend 12/12 PASS (pytest), all 6 admin endpoints respond with correct shape + RBAC. Frontend: both /admin/governance and /admin/compliance-findings load, all required data-testids present and populated from live preview data (score=0/100 Critical, 305 open + 3 resolved findings, 2 rules represented). Filter bar, severity/status/rule deep-linking, run-scan refresh, ack→resolve dialog flow, status=resolved view, mobile responsive (grid-cols-2 stacks at 390px), AdminShell governance nav link, RBAC redirect for anon, and 401 rejection of PM token against admin endpoints — all verified.

issues: Memorial Day remembrance banner at top of every admin page is large (consumes ~150px vertical space). Has working close-X. Does NOT block interaction, but reduces above-the-fold real estate on first paint. Likely intentional per main agent note — flagged as informational only.

critical_code_review_comments: Search filter on /admin/compliance-findings appears to match against entity_name only — searching 'archived' returns 0 results despite 73 EMP_ARCHIVED_ACTIVE findings whose description contains the word 'archived'. Backend pytest test_search_filter_narrows_results passes so the filter IS working on entity_name as designed, but operators may expect description text to also be searched. Consider broadening backend regex to include description field for better UX (LOW priority — backend search field is currently entity_name only by design).

AdminShell side-nav is in a scrollable column; on a 1080px desktop viewport governance link sits below the fold and requires scroll to reach. Cosmetic only — link works (verified via direct navigation).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 endpoints (POST /api/admin/compliance/scan, GET /api/admin/compliance/findings, GET /api/admin/compliance/findings/{id}, POST /api/admin/compliance/findings/{id}/acknowledge, POST /api/admin/compliance/findings/{id}/resolve, GET /api/admin/governance/summary) verified. RBAC: anon=401, PM-token=401, admin-token=200. Frontend pages /admin/governance and /admin/compliance-findings fully functional including: 5-tile severity strip with deep-links, 3 status pills, 2 rule rows in table, run-scan button refreshes last-scan-rel to '1s ago', view-findings nav, filter bar (severity/status/rule/category/search + refresh + clear), URL deep-linking for both ?severity= and ?rule_id= preselects filters and narrows results, ack/resolve dialog flow with finding-action-note + finding-action-submit works end-to-end, resolved findings disappear from default view and show under ?status=resolved, ack/resolve buttons correctly absent on resolved rows. Mobile 390px: severity strip uses grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-5 (stacks correctly). admin-nav-governance link present and functional. No mocks, all live preview MongoDB data.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Implementation meets spec.
